resources.string:
Finding a hymn
• Enter a hymn number and tap the hymnal button to show lyrics and score.
• Or browse by category, stroke count, pinyin or the English–Chinese index.
• Content search: type words and tap Search; long-press Search to turn 他 into 祂.

Lyrics page
• Long-press the page to open the menu.
• Swipe left or right for the previous or next hymn.
• Turn the phone sideways for larger lyrics and score; the player hides automatically.

Playing media
• Tap Play to start, tap again to pause, and again to resume.
• Long-press Play to restart from the beginning.

Media configuration
• Add your own audio or video links for each hymn, and export or import them to share with other devices.
• Media files you download yourself go under Download/hymnal/.

Updates
• About → Update checks for a new version. After it downloads, tap the notification to install.
